original_title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Is Pushing for a Physical Edition, But Nothing Has Been Decided
summary_en: Despite the industry's shift towards digital, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth's director is actively advocating for a physical release. Fans of the beloved RPG may soon have their voices heard in this ongoing internal discussion.
ai_analysis: This is a significant development for fans who value physical media, highlighting the ongoing tension between digital distribution and collector desires within the modern gaming landscape.

en.title: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth Director Pushes for Physical Edition
en.summary: Despite the industry's shift towards digital, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth's director is actively advocating for a physical release. Fans of the beloved RPG may soon have their voices heard in this ongoing internal discussion.
en.body:
The future of physical game releases remains a hot topic, and **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** is no exception. Director **Naoki Hamaguchi** has revealed that he is actively pushing for a physical edition of the highly anticipated PlayStation 5 title, though no definitive decisions have been made yet.

Speaking with GamesRadar, Hamaguchi acknowledged the ongoing internal discussions regarding the game's SKU product lineup. While he couldn't offer concrete guarantees this far out from release, his personal commitment to a physical option is clear. "I am working to make the arrangements to allow us to have some kind of physical edition," he stated. He also touched upon the complexities introduced by different platform holders and their specific regulations, such as storage limitations on game cartridges, which influence these decisions. The goal, he emphasized, is to satisfy fans as much as possible. > "Each platform and first-party have their own specific rules and regulations that we need to take into account, and think about what format is actually going to be best for the game. These are the discussions that we're having at this point in time. I do hope that we'll be able to come up with something that is as close as possible as to what players and fans are going to want, but you'll have to look forward to future announcements for that."

## The Collector's Dilemma

For many long-time fans of the **Final Fantasy** series and gaming in general, the prospect of a digital-only release for a title as significant as **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** is a disheartening one. Physical editions offer more than just a copy of the game; they represent tangible pieces of art, collectibles that can be displayed, traded, and preserved. The ability to own a game outright, without reliance on digital storefronts that can change or disappear, holds immense value for a dedicated player base. Hamaguchi himself even joked that he fears fans would "rip him to pieces" if a physical version wasn't made available, underscoring the community's strong feelings on the matter. His personal optimism that there will always be some form of physical artifact, even if it's just a code card, reflects an understanding of this enduring fan desire.

## What's Next for Rebirth's Release

With **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** still approximately a year away from its launch, the final product lineup, including the potential for a physical edition, is still being finalized. Fans eager to secure a physical copy should keep a close eye on official announcements from Square Enix regarding pre-orders and special editions. Future updates will provide clarity on whether Hamaguchi's advocacy will translate into a tangible product for collectors worldwide.

tr.title: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth'in Fiziksel Sürümü İçin Direktör Hamaguchi Çaba Sarf Ediyor
tr.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth'in direktörü Naoki Hamaguchi, oyunun fiziksel bir sürümünün çıkması için çaba sarf ediyor. Sevenleri, bu konuda içerdeki tartışmalarda seslerini duyurabilecekler.
tr.body:
Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, fiziksel oyun sürümlerinin geleceği konusunda önemli bir örnek teşkil ediyor. Direktör Naoki Hamaguchi, GamesRadar'a yaptığı açıklamada, highly anticipated PlayStation 5 başlıklarından birinin fiziksel sürümünün çıkması için çaba sarf ettiğini belirtti. Ancak henüz kesin kararlar alınmış değil.

## Fiziksel Sürümün Önemi

Hamaguchi, oyunun SKU ürün hattı ile ilgili içerdeki tartışmalara değindi. Çıkış tarihine kadar somut garantiler veremese de, fiziksel bir seçenek için kişisel taahhüdünü net bir şekilde ortaya koydu. "Fiziksel bir sürüm için必要 arrangementsını yapmak için çalışıyorum" dedi. Ayrıca, farklı platform sahiplerinin ve onların spesifik düzenlemelerinin, depolama limitleri gibi karmaşıklıkların bu kararları etkilediğini belirtti. Hedef, fanları mümkün olduğunca memnun etmek. > "Her platform ve birinci tarafın kendi spesifik kuralları ve düzenlemeleri var, bunları dikkate almak ve oyun için en iyi formatı düşünmek gerekiyor. Şu anda bunları tartışıyoruz. Umarım, oyuncuların ve fanların istedikleri şeylere mümkün olduğunca yakın bir şey ortaya koyabileceğiz, ancak bundan sonraki açıklamaları beklemelisiniz."

## Koleksiyoncu İkilemi

Final Fantasy serisi ve genel olarak oyun severleri için, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth gibi önemli bir başlığın sadece dijital olarak çıkması düşüncesi pek de hoş karşılanmıyor. Fiziksel sürümler, sadece oyunun bir kopyasını sunmakla kalmaz, aynı zamanda dokunulabilir sanat parçaları, koleksiyonlar ve saklanabilir öğeler sunar. Dijital mağazalara bağımlı olmadan oyunu satın almak, sadık bir oyuncu kitlesi için büyük bir değer taşır. Hamaguchi, fiziksel bir sürüm çıkarmazlarsa fanların kendisini "parça parça" edeceklerinden söz ederek, topluluğun bu konudaki güçlü duygularını vurguladı. Fiziksel bir artifactın, en azından bir kod kartı şeklinde, her zaman olacağına dair kişisel optimizmi, bu süregelen fan isteğinin anlaşılmasını yansıtıyor.

## Rebirth'in Çıkışının Geleceği

Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth'in çıkış tarihine yaklaşık bir yıl kaldı ve ürün hattı, fiziksel sürüm dahil, hala finalleştiriliyor. Fiziksel kopya edinmek isteyen fanlar, Square Enix'in ön sipariş ve özel sürümler hakkında resmi açıklamalarını yakından takip etmeliler. Gelecek güncellemeler, Hamaguchi'nin savunuculuğunun koleksiyoncular dünya çapında somut bir ürün haline gelip gelmeyeceğini açıklığa kavuşturacak.

es.title: El director de Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth aboga por una edición física
es.summary: A pesar del giro de la industria hacia lo digital, el director de Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth está activamente abogando por una edición física. Los fanáticos del RPG más querido pueden pronto ver sus voces escuchadas en esta discusión interna en curso. La decisión final aún no se ha tomado, pero la pasión del director por una edición física es clara.
es.body:
El futuro de las ediciones físicas de juegos sigue siendo un tema candente, y **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** no es la excepción. El director **Naoki Hamaguchi** ha revelado que está trabajando activamente para lograr una edición física del esperado título de PlayStation 5, aunque aún no se han tomado decisiones definitivas.

 
   Al hablar con GamesRadar, Hamaguchi reconoció las discusiones internas en curso sobre la línea de productos SKU del juego. Aunque no pudo ofrecer garantías concretas en este momento, su compromiso personal con una opción física es claro. > "Estoy trabajando para hacer los arreglos para permitir que tengamos algún tipo de edición física", dijo. También tocó sobre las complejidades introducidas por los titulares de diferentes plataformas y sus regulaciones específicas, como las limitaciones de almacenamiento en cartuchos de juegos, que influyen en estas decisiones. El objetivo, enfatizó, es satisfacer a los fanáticos tanto como sea posible. > "Cada plataforma y primera parte tiene sus propias reglas y regulaciones que debemos tener en cuenta, y pensar en qué formato es realmente el mejor para el juego. Estas son las discusiones que estamos teniendo en este momento. Espero que podamos llegar a algo que esté lo más cerca posible de lo que los jugadores y fanáticos quieren, pero tendrán que esperar a futuros anuncios para eso".

 
   ## El Dilema del Coleccionista
 
   Para muchos fanáticos de largo tiempo de la serie **Final Fantasy** y del gaming en general, la perspectiva de una edición digital solo para un título tan significativo como **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** es desalentadora. Las ediciones físicas ofrecen más que solo una copia del juego; representan piezas tangibles de arte, coleccionables que se pueden exhibir, intercambiar y preservar. La capacidad de poseer un juego de manera directa, sin depender de tiendas digitales que pueden cambiar o desaparecer, tiene un valor inmenso para una base de jugadores dedicada. Hamaguchi incluso bromeó que teme que los fanáticos lo "despedazarían" si no se lanzara una edición física, subrayando los sentimientos fuertes de la comunidad sobre el asunto. Su optimismo personal de que siempre habrá alguna forma de artefacto físico, incluso si es solo una tarjeta de código, refleja una comprensión de este deseo de fanático duradero.

 
   ## Próximos Pasos para el Lanzamiento de Rebirth
 
   Con **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** aún aproximadamente un año lejos de su lanzamiento, la línea de productos final, incluida la posible edición física, aún se está finalizando. Los fanáticos ansiosos por asegurar una copia física deben mantener un ojo cercano en los anuncios oficiales de Square Enix sobre preventas y ediciones especiales. Las actualizaciones futuras proporcionarán claridad sobre si la defensa de Hamaguchi se traducirá en un producto tangible para coleccionistas de todo el mundo.

content_raw: There's a chance that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation may not have a physical edition, but the director of the game is actively pushing to avoid that. When speaking with GamesRadar , director Naoki Hamaguchi was asked about the state of physical games and whether or not Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will receive a physical disc. Given the game is still almost a year away from release , Hamaguchi was unable to make any guarantees, but admitted that it is something important to him. “We’re still having internal discussions on what the exact SKU product lineup is going to be for Revelation,” said Hamaguchi, “So, I can’t say anything particularly definitive at this point in time. But I am working to make the arrangements to allow us to have some kind of physical edition.” He noted that platforms like Nintendo have certain rules, such as storage limits with things like game cartridges, which can make these decisions challenging. But ultimately, he hopes to have something that satisfies fans to the best of their ability. "Each platform and first-party have their own specific rules and regulations that we need to take into account, and think about what format is actually going to be best for the game. These are the discussions that we're having at this point in time. I do hope that we'll be able to come up with something that is as close as possible as to what players and fans are going to want, but you'll have to look forward to future announcements for that." He also joked that fans will "rip him to pieces" if the game doesn't have a physical edition following these comments. As for his personal feelings, Hamaguchi noted he is optimistic that there will always be some kind of physical item, even if it's just a code in the box or game key card, and values the ability to have a physical item commemorating the game that fans can cherish. “I do feel, as a developer and as a fan, that the general trend is for things to shift away from physical towards downloadable games. But that’s obviously talking about the trend. Personally, here at something like Fan Fest or at community events for games that I’ve worked on, I really think that people bringing up things, asking for autographs. I think that’s lovely. I think it’s a wonderful culture and it would be a shame to lose that. I want that to remain.” Although PlayStation's digital-only strategy won't begin until January 2028 , almost a year after Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's release, that hasn't stopped some games from going all digital beforehand. Grand Theft Auto 6 will not release on a disc when it launches in November, and reports suggest there are no plans for that to change . While GTA 6 is a unique case and the move is likely being done to avoid leaks ahead of release, it wouldn't be surprising if other companies begin to pull back on physical as PlayStation ramps up its digital future. Will Final Fantasy 7 Revelation be the next game to go all-digital? Only time will tell. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's
